descriptions.notStarted: I have passed all of #p2101003#'s test. Now I will be accepted as a member of the Sand Bandits, right? I better go talk to #p2101003#.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101003# told me the Sand Bandits will need to get stronger in order to fight the queen, and told me if I could beat him, then I'll be accepted as the member of the Sand Bandits... Will I be able to defeat #p2101003#? \n\nArdin's Other Self#r#a39331##k
descriptions.completed: He may look slow and clumsy, but #p2101003# was much more powerful that I envisioned, but I still won the battle, so am I now a member of the Sand Bandits? #p2101003# told me in order to be a member of the Sand Bandits, I have to be approved by two more members. Come to think of it, other than iron hammer, #p2103001# also had bow, arrows, and dagger written on the wall.
